column1: # c-imagine F2V 2.0 palette manifest (M6 palette channel, measured surface)
# Format (TSV): modded_item <TAB> base_sprite <TAB> palette_key_png <TAB> separator <TAB> variants
#   - the 26.3-native recolor surface: paletted_permutations is an ATLAS
#     assets/minecraft/atlases/items.json with THIS source — pack atlas json
#     APPENDS to the vanilla source stack (SpriteSourceList.load =
#     getResourceStack + addAll), so vanilla trims keep working.
#   - modded_item: the base items-manifest row id; its variant rows
#     (<id>@<suffix>) ride the SAME host range_dispatch at cmd base+1+i.
#   - base_sprite: the TEXTURE sprite id the permutations recolor.
#   - palette_key_png / perm PNGs: FULL jar resource paths; copied at
#     original textures/ paths (the palette matcher is EXACT ARGB per pixel).
#   - only rows listed here enter the pack (manifest-driven).
